news.title: US futures ease after Monday's historic rally
news.text: Index futures pulled back Tuesday morning after Monday's S&P 500 (+4.73%) and Nasdaq posted their best days since April 2025. A premarket digest put S&P futures down roughly 0.3-0.8% and Nasdaq-100 futures down 0.8-1.7% in early trade, giving back a slice of the gains.

news.title: Analog Devices reports before today's open; chip names cautious
news.text: ADI released fiscal Q4 FY2026 results at 7:00am ET today per its scheduled release. Broader semiconductor and AI-linked names, including several comm-equipment names on the watchlist, traded cautiously in early Tuesday action as investors weighed the report against last week's volatility.

news.title: HPE slides premarket despite beating estimates, on cash-flow concerns
news.text: Hewlett Packard Enterprise topped profit expectations but shares fell sharply premarket after a report flagged unpaid supplier bills growing to $9.4B against $6.6B of operating cash flow, reviving scrutiny of cash-flow quality.
